verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair question for a sandbox SDK or platform, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, usage tracking, or any opt-out control. The docs cover execution, files, sessions and networking, and the community items discuss pricing, startup time and outbound control, none of which is about telemetry.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
